methodology: Quarry breadth-first hunt — curl + browser, blind injection, exploit crafting

findings.title: SQL Injection — basic string and numeric injection
findings.technique: String injection via ' OR '1'='1 and numeric injection via 0 OR 1=1

findings.title: SQL Injection Advanced — UNION and stacked queries
findings.technique: Stacked query: '; SELECT * FROM user_system_data--

findings.title: SQL Injection Mitigations — blind ORDER BY injection
findings.technique: Boolean-based blind ORDER BY via CASE WHEN to extract IP char-by-char

findings.title: XXE — XML External Entity injection
findings.technique: External entity reading file:///etc/passwd

findings.title: Path Traversal — directory traversal in file upload
findings.technique: Multipart upload with fullName=../test

findings.title: JWT — alg:none token forgery
findings.technique: Forged JWT with alg:none, admin:true via access_token cookie

findings.title: Password Reset — insecure reset flow via email interception
findings.technique: Triggered password reset, intercepted email from built-in mailbox (/WebGoat/mail), extracted reset token, submitted new password via change-password endpoint, verified login with new credentials

findings.title: Authentication Bypass — parameter name manipulation
findings.technique: Changed secQuestion0/1 to secQuestion2/3

findings.title: Insecure Login — cleartext credentials
findings.technique: Known credentials CaptainJack/BlackPearl over HTTP

findings.title: Reflected XSS — script injection in form field
findings.technique: GET with <script>alert('xss')</script> in field1

findings.title: DOM-based XSS — phoneHome() execution
findings.technique: Executed webgoat.customjs.phoneHome() via browser JS

findings.title: Stored XSS — persistent script in comment
findings.technique: POST JSON with <script>webgoat.customjs.phoneHome()</script>

findings.title: IDOR — profile enumeration
findings.technique: Login as Tom (2342384), enumerate to find Buffalo Bill (2342388)

findings.title: Missing Function Level Access Control
findings.technique: Hidden admin endpoints discovered and accessed
findings.data_leaked: User list with admin flags and password hashes

findings.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery — flag extraction
findings.technique: Cross-origin POST with external Referer extracts flag

findings.title: Client-Side Filtering — salary/SSN data leak
findings.technique: GET to salary endpoint returns all employees' SSN and salary

findings.title: Client-Side Tampering — price manipulation
findings.technique: POST with Total=0.00 bypasses client-side validation

findings.title: Cryptography Basics — Base64 Authorization header decode
findings.technique: Base64 decode of Authorization header reveals credentials

findings.title: Vulnerable Components — XStream CVE-2013-7285 RCE
findings.technique: XStream deserialization via EventHandler proxy → ProcessBuilder

findings.title: Server-Side Request Forgery
findings.technique: URL manipulation to access internal (jerry.png) and external (ifconfig.pro) resources

findings.title: Insecure Deserialization — VulnerableTaskHolder RCE
findings.technique: Crafted serialized VulnerableTaskHolder(sleep 5) inside Docker container. 5-second delay confirmed.
